# Canada Learning Code

> Canada Learning Code democratizes technology education and career development across Canada through workshops, mentorship, and the Career Collective platform.

Canada Learning Code is a nonprofit organization dedicated to increasing digital literacy and tech equity by providing coding education, professional development, and career advancement opportunities to underrepresented communities. The organization operates through community workshops, volunteer mentorship, and strategic partnerships with sponsors and donors.

## Core Programs & Services

- [Homepage](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca): Canada Learning Code homepage showcasing tech education and Career Collective.
- [Career Collective](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/career-collective): Career Collective platform offering tech skills training and professional development.
- [Workshops & Events](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/events): Workshops and events for hands-on coding education and career development.
- [Workshop Series for Community and Nonprofit Organizations](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/community-org-workshop-series): Workshop series on AI and machine learning for nonprofit organizations.

## Organization

- [About Us](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/about-us): Organization mission, vision, and impact on digital literacy and tech equity.
- [Our Team](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/our-team): Leadership team and staff directory including board and headquarters team.

## Support & Community

- [Donate Today](https://canadalearningcode.ca/donate): Donation page for supporting Canada Learning Code's technology education mission.
- [Volunteer](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities in tech education mentorship and community involvement.
- [Sponsors](https://www.canadalearningcode.ca/sponsors): Sponsor and donor information including Fortinet and JP Bickell Foundation.
